Title: Succesful bleed vs Succesful D action

Messages.Author: 2wayspeaker
Messages.Body:
A bleed for 0 is not a succesful bleed.
But is it a succesful  action?

1) If Shemti where to play Ecstasy on a bleed of 1. Would the minion lose 2 blood or only 1?

2) If 2 FOS play Ectasy on superior, does the minion burn 2 blood? One from each Ecstasy? While the bleed resolves for -1?

> Shemti
> [vic]
> [OBF]
> [POT]
>
> [SER]
>
> [Follower of Set] Follower of Set
>
> Capacity: 9
>
> Group: 5
>
> Independent: Shemti has 1 vote (titled). While he is ready and untapped, any minion successfully performing a  action against you takes 1 damage (after resolving the action).
>
> Ecstasy
>
> [Reaction] Reaction
>
> [Serpentis] Serpentis
>
> [ser] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
> [SER] As above, and if the bleed resolves for 0 (or less), the acting minion burns 1 blood or life (after resolving the action).
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> A bleed for 0 is not a succesful bleed.
> But is it a succesful  action?
>
The bleed action is successful, but the bleed is not.

> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> 1) If Shemti where to play Ecstasy on a bleed of 1. Would the minion lose 2 blood or only 1?
>
2.

> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> 2) If 2 FOS play Ectasy on superior, does the minion burn 2 blood? One from each Ecstasy? While the bleed resolves for -1?
>
Yes.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> 1) If Shemti where to play Ecstasy on a bleed of 1. Would the minion lose 2 blood or only 1?

2.

Technically the minion would lose (burn) 1 blood and take a damage, however, in what order would that happen? Are they at the same time so ordered by the acting methuselah, or would Ecstasy resolve before Shemti's special?

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body: I just read and realized that they resolve at the same time, so the acting Meth can order it
